question: PT Usha was elected as the president of which association in December 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Olympic Association**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PT Usha** was elected as the president of the **Indian Olympic Association** in** December 2022**.
 
• She is one of India's most celebrated athletes, often referred to as the "**Queen of Indian track and field**."
 
• Her election marks a significant milestone as she is the first woman to hold this prestigious position.
 
• The Indian Olympic Association is responsible for the preparation and participation of Indian athletes in the Olympic Games and other international multi-sport events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PT Usha** has received numerous awards, including the **Padma Shri** and the **Arjuna Award**, for her contributions to Indian sports.
 
• Her election as the president of the Indian Olympic Association is expected to bring a renewed focus on the development of athletics and other sports in India.
 
• The **Indian Olympic Association** was established in **1927 **and is recognized by the International Olympic Committee.
 
• It plays a crucial role in promoting the Olympic movement in India and supporting athletes in their quest for excellence at the international level.
